1.name: Auridon
1.description: The second largest of the Summerset Isles, Auridon has always served the High Elves as a buffer between their serene archipelago and the turmoil of Tamriel. The Altmer of Auridon have been hardened by generations of repelling invaders, pirates, and plagues.

1.name: Tanzelwil
1.openingText: Help the Queen uphold High Elf traditions.
1.closingText: You defeated a traitor and saved the Queen.

2.name: Firsthold
2.openingText: Save Firsthold from the Veiled Queen.
2.closingText: You defeated High Kinlady Estre, the Veiled Queen.

3.name: Skywatch
3.openingText: Help Razum-dar defeat the Veiled Heritance at Skywatch.
3.closingText: You revealed Estre as the Veiled Queen at Skywatch.

4.name: Vulkhel Guard
4.openingText: Support the City Watch in Vulkhel Guard.
4.closingText: You foiled an assassination attempt on Queen Ayrenn.

5.name: Mathiisen
5.openingText: Investigate the Heritance presence in Mathiisen.
5.closingText: You defeated the Veiled Heritance in Mathiisen.

2.name: Grahtwood
2.description: This region is the southern heart of the Wood Elves' great forest, and home to more of the gigantic graht-oaks than any other part of Valenwood. Its capital, now also the capital of the entire Aldmeri Dominion, is Elden Root.

1.name: Reliquary of Stars
1.openingText: Uncover the secrets buried in the Reliquary of Stars.
1.closingText: You defeated Ukaezai and recovered the Heart of Anumaril.

3.name: Falinesti Winter Site
3.openingText: Discover the mystery of the Falinesti Winter Site.
3.closingText: You've uncovered the mystery of the Falinesti Winter Site.

4.name: Elden Root
4.openingText: Quell unrest in the city of Elden Root.
4.closingText: You've united the people of the Aldmeri Dominion.

3.name: Greenshade
3.description: Greenshade, a land of flowing rivers and fertile plains, occupies the southwest portion of Valenwood. The port city of Woodhearth sits upon the western shore, while other towns include Marbruk and Greenheart.

1.name: Seaside Sanctuary
1.openingText: Drive back the Maormer invasion at Seaside Sanctuary.
1.closingText: You defeated the Maormer and killed Vicereeve Pelidil.

2.name: Hectahame
2.openingText: Defeat Prince Naemon and restore the Heart of Valenwood!
2.closingText: Naemon is defeated. The Heart of Valenwood is restored.

3.name: Greenheart
3.closingText: You saved the Court of the Wilderqueen.

4.name: Bramblebreach
4.openingText: Negotiate with the Bramblebreach clan for the Dominion.
4.closingText: You exposed a Veiled Heritance plot to kill the Wilderking.

5.name: Woodhearth
5.openingText: Put a stop to Pelidil's plans in Woodhearth.
5.closingText: You exposed a plot to destroy the Aldmeri Dominion.

6.name: Dread Vullain
6.openingText: Discover the reason why the cursed dead have risen.
6.closingText: You released General Malgoth's army from the Shade.

7.name: Verrant Morass
7.openingText: Discover the source of the blight.
7.closingText: You cleansed Verrant Morass of the Shade's blight.

8.name: Driladan Pass
8.openingText: Help the Dominion defeat the undead army.
8.closingText: The undead army has been defeated.

4.name: Malabal Tor
4.description: Malabal Tor is the northwest region of Valenwood, on the coast of the Abecean Sea and the Strid River estuary. Its capital is Silvenar, the spiritual home of all Wood Elves.

1.name: Silvenar
1.openingText: Defeat the Hound and free the city.
1.closingText: You have defeated the Hound and freed Silvenar.

2.name: Dra'bul
2.openingText: Help the Green Lady investigate the Drublog compound.
2.closingText: You foiled a plot to capture the Green Lady by the Drublog.

4.name: Velyn Harbor
4.openingText: Free Velyn Harbor from Drublog and Redguard invaders.
4.closingText: You've freed Velyn Harbor from invading forces!

5.name: Reaper's March
5.description: Once known simply as Northern Valenwood, this region that borders Cyrodiil and Elsweyr has seen so much bloody warfare since the fall of the Second Empire that it's now known as Reaper's March, even to its battle-scarred inhabitants.

1.name: Moonmont
1.openingText: Deal with the Dark Mane's corruption.
1.closingText: You have defeated the Dark Mane.

2.name: Rawl'kha
2.openingText: Help the Lunar Champion begin a spiritual journey.
2.closingText: You helped the Lunar Champion complete a vision quest.

3.name: Two Moons Path
3.openingText: Walk the Two Moons Path with the Lunar Champion.
3.closingText: You helped the Lunar Champion walk the Two Moons Path.

4.name: Fort Grimwatch
4.openingText: Drive the dark spirits from Fort Grimwatch.
4.closingText: You have defeated the Dro-m'Athra and saved Fort Grimwatch.

5.name: Arenthia
5.openingText: Aid Cariel and the Arenthian Resistance.
5.closingText: You drove the Colovians away and stopped the Dark Mane.

6.name: Dune
6.closingText: You rescued the town of Dune from the Daedra.

1.name: Deshaan
1.description: The fertile valleys of Deshaan are home to lush fungal forests, deep kwama mines, and broad pastures where netches and guar graze. But all pales before the magnificence of Mournhold, home of the Tribunal and capital of the Ebonheart Pact.

1.name: Obsidian Gorge
1.openingText: Find out why Maulborn are occupying the pass.
1.closingText: You discovered a cure for the Llodos plague.

2.name: Eidolon's Hollow
2.openingText: Put an end to the threat of Magistrix Vox.
2.closingText: You defeated Magistrix Vox and freed the captured spirits.

3.name: Tribunal Temple
3.openingText: Protect the Tribunal Temple from the Maulborn menace.
3.closingText: You stopped the Maulborn and saved the Tribunal Temple.

4.name: Mournhold
4.openingText: Find out what's happening in the city of Mournhold.
4.closingText: You uncovered a dangerous plot against the Tribunal.

5.name: Shrine of Saint Veloth
5.openingText: Restore Saint Veloth and stop the Daedric incursion.
5.closingText: You restored Saint Veloth and stopped the Daedric incursion.

2.name: Eastmarch
2.description: One of the "Old Holds," Eastmarch was among the first regions of Skyrim settled by the Nords when they arrived from Atmora. Its capital, Windhelm, is the oldest continuously inhabited human settlement in Tamriel, and was founded by Ysgramor himself.

1.name: Mistwatch
1.openingText: Help the Ternion Monks save King Jorunn.
1.closingText: You helped the Ternions save King Jorunn.

2.name: Skuldafn
2.openingText: Reach the dragonshrine and stop Fildgor's vile plot.
2.closingText: You stopped Fildgor and solidified the Ebonheart Pact.

3.name: Windhelm
3.openingText: Keep the Nord celebration safe and sound.
3.closingText: You protected the celebration and saved King Jorunn.

4.name: Cradlecrush
4.openingText: Destroy the Stormfist legion holding Cradlecrush.
4.closingText: You defeated the Stormfist legion at Cradlecrush.

5.name: Fort Amol
5.openingText: Assist the leaders of the Ebonheart Pact.
5.closingText: You saved Fort Amol from the Stormfist duplicates.

6.name: Wittestadr
6.closingText: You helped end the vampire feud of Wittestadr.

7.name: Jorunn's Stand
7.openingText: Help Prince Irnskar strengthen the alliance.
7.closingText: You helped prepare the Ebonheart Pact to go to war.

3.name: Shadowfen
3.description: On the border with Morrowind, the Shadowfen region has had more contact with Tamrielic civilization than most of Black Marsh—due primarily to the activities of the Dunmeri slavers who once operated out of the city of Stormhold. Now the Argonians are back in charge.

1.name: Ten-Maur-Wolk
1.closingText: You defeated the skin-stealers at Ten-Maur-Wolk.

2.name: Hatching Pools
2.openingText: Determine the Dominion's purpose in Hatching Pools.
2.closingText: You saved a generation of Argonian eggs from the Dominion.

3.name: Loriasel
3.openingText: Stop Ruuvitar from corrupting the Mnemic Egg.
3.closingText: You've recovered the Mnemic Egg from the Dominion.

4.name: Stormhold
4.openingText: Discover who's behind the murders in Stormhold.
4.closingText: You exposed the Dominion threat within Stormhold.

4.name: Stonefalls
4.description: The ashfall from the volcanoes of the Velothi Mountains and from great Ash Mountain itself is Stonefalls' bane and benefit, fertilizing the soil where the land isn't too arid to grow crops. It was here that the recent invading army from Akavir met its bloody end.

1.name: Fort Virak
1.openingText: Repel Covenant forces from Fort Virak.
1.closingText: You've saved Fort Virak from Covenant forces.

2.name: Ash Mountain
2.closingText: You've imprisoned Balreth inside Ash Mountain.

3.name: Tormented Spire
3.openingText: Stop Tanval from unleashing the second Brother of Strife.
3.closingText: You stopped Tanval and saved Stonefalls.

4.name: Davon's Watch
4.openingText: Stop the Covenant invasion of Davon's Watch.
4.closingText: You've saved Davon's Watch from an invading army.

5.name: Othrenis
5.openingText: Find Mavos' tomb and wake him.
5.closingText: Mavos taught you how to defeat Balreth.

6.name: Vivec's Antlers
6.openingText: Stop the Covenant from getting the Coral Heart.
6.closingText: You've slain Alexandra Conele and secured the Coral Heart.

7.name: Kragenmoor
7.openingText: Free Kragenmoor from the grip of Tanval's Vanguard.
7.closingText: You've restored Kragenmoor to House Dres control.

5.name: The Rift
5.description: Skyrim's southernmost hold has a relatively temperate climate, thanks to northern mountains that block the frigid gales of the Sea of Ghosts, and warming volcanoes in the Velothi Mountains to the east. Its capital is Riften, on the shores of broad Lake Honrich.

1.name: Vernim Woods
1.closingText: You've slain Stral Blackthroat, leader of the Reachmen.

2.name: Honrich Tower
2.openingText: Help King Jorunn defeat the Worm Cult at Honrich Tower.
2.closingText: Thallik Wormtongue was defeated but Wuuthrad was shattered!

3.name: Trolhetta
3.openingText: Help the Ebonheart Pact defeat the Worm Cult.
3.closingText: With your aid, the Ebonheart Pact defeated the Worm Cult.

4.name: Taarengrav
4.openingText: Strike back against the Cult at Taarengrav.
4.closingText: You saved the ancient Companion, Valdur.

5.name: Pinepeak Cavern
5.openingText: Learn why the Worm Cult are at Pinepeak Cavern.
5.closingText: You saved the ancient Companion, Hakra.

1.name: Alik'r Desert
1.description: Though there are fertile fields on the coast near the capital city of Sentinel, it is the arid expanses of the interior that have captured the hearts of the rugged Redguards. The Alik'r is rich in mineral resources, but its fierce creatures and harsh terrain are daunting to most.

1.name: Tava's Blessing
1.openingText: Stop the Withered Hand plot at Tava's Blessing.
1.closingText: You've defeated the Withered Hand at Tava's Blessing.

2.name: Motalion Necropolis
2.openingText: Defeat Shiri and reclaim the final Ansei Ward.
2.closingText: You've stopped Shiri and reclaimed the Ansei Wards.

3.name: Tu'whacca's Throne
3.openingText: Stop Uwafa from raising the dead at Tu'whacca's Throne.
3.closingText: You defeated Uwafa and recovered one of the Ansei Wards.

4.name: Sentinel
4.openingText: Investigate the necromancers' plot in Sentinel.
4.closingText: You uncovered the Withered Hand's plot in Sentinel.

2.name: Bangkorai
2.description: This region takes its name from its most famous feature, the Bangkorai Pass, which has served as High Rock's defense against the wild raiders of Hammerfell for countless generations. The uplands north of the pass and the desert to the south are both ruled from the port city of Evermore.

1.name: Jackdaw Cove
1.openingText: Slay Uela the Hagraven to put an end to the Reachmen threat.
1.closingText: You slew Uela the Hagraven, ending the Reachmen threat.

2.name: Bangkorai Garrison
2.openingText: Retake the garrison from the Imperial Army.
2.closingText: You've reclaimed the garrison for the Daggerfall Covenant.

3.name: Hall of Heroes
3.openingText: Help King Emeric defeat the Imperials at the Hall of Heroes.
3.closingText: You saved King Emeric's soul and restored him to life.

4.name: Evermore
4.openingText: Defend the city against its enemies.
4.closingText: You foiled an Imperial plot to take control of the city.

3.name: Glenumbra
3.description: Glenumbra, the westernmost region of High Rock, contains the city-states of Daggerfall and Camlorn, the great cemetery of Cath Bedraud, and the wild areas of Hag Fen, Glenumbra Moors, and the forests of Daenia.

1.name: Camlorn
1.openingText: Lead the effort to retake Camlorn.
1.closingText: Faolchu is dead and Camlorn has been saved.

2.name: Beldama Wyrd Tree
2.openingText: Remove Angof's corruption from the Wyrd Tree.
2.closingText: You removed Angof's corruption and saved the Wyrd Tree.

3.name: Cath Bedraud
3.closingText: You defeated Angof the Gravesinger and saved Glenumbra.

4.name: Lion Guard Redoubt
4.openingText: Help the Lion Guard Redoubt hold the line against Angof.
4.closingText: You discovered a way to defeat Angof the Gravesinger.

4.name: Rivenspire
4.description: This northwestern region of High Rock contains some of the province's most dramatic terrain, including towering, flinty crags, windswept moors, and narrow canyons. Many folk find the environment oppressive, even threatening.

1.name: Camp Tamrith
1.openingText: Help the Camp Tamrith refugees and the Shornhelm Guard.
1.closingText: You killed Reezal-Jul and helped the Camp Tamrith refugees.

2.name: Lorkrata Hills
2.openingText: Help Verandis Ravenwatch locate the secret of Lorkrata.
2.closingText: You helped Verandis attain an ancient Ayleid tome.

3.name: The Doomcrag
3.openingText: Ascend the mountain and put an end to Baron Montclair.
3.closingText: You defeated Baron Montclair and destroyed the Doomcrag.

4.name: Shornhelm
4.openingText: Help free the upper city from Montclair forces.
4.closingText: You discovered the truth behind the threat to Rivenspire.

5.name: Ravenwatch Castle
5.openingText: Get Count Ravenwatch to tell you about Baron Montclair.
5.closingText: You learned the secret behind Baron Montclair's power.

6.name: Northpoint
6.openingText: Infiltrate the besieged city of Northpoint and set it free.
6.closingText: You defeated Lleraya and saved the city of Northpoint.

5.name: Stormhaven
5.description: Situated at the head of the strategic Iliac Bay, Stormhaven is the geographic center of High Rock, and also the home of the great trading city of Wayrest, capital of the Daggerfall Covenant.

1.name: Shinji's Scarp
1.openingText: Help the Murtag clan stop the Ironhand ogres.
1.closingText: You've helped the Murtag clan stop the Ironhand ogres.

2.name: at-Tura Estate
2.openingText: Recover the stolen Dream Shard from Hosni at-Tura.
2.closingText: You recovered the Dream Shard and can now stop Vaermina.

3.name: Firebrand Keep
3.openingText: Reunify the Knights of the Flame.
3.closingText: You reunified the Knights of the Flame.

4.name: Alcaire Keep
4.openingText: Resolve the military standoff that threatens the Covenant.
4.closingText: Exposed Sir Hughes's dreams and resolved the standoff.

5.name: Pariah Abbey
5.openingText: Restore order to Pariah Abbey and save the Spirit Wardens.
5.closingText: You saved Pariah Abbey and the Spirit Wardens.

skills.description:
Steal an enemy's life force, dealing |cffffff11271|r Magic Damage and healing you for |cffffff35|r% of the damage inflicted every |cffffff2|r seconds for |cffffff10|r seconds.

Deals |cffffff1|r% more damage for every |cffffff2|r% Health you have.

skills.name: Scalding Rune
skills.description:
Inscribe a rune of cosmic fire on the earth, which takes |cffffff2|r seconds to arm and lasts for |cffffff22|r seconds.

When triggered, the rune blasts all enemies in the target area for |cffffff10250|r Flame Damage and an additional |cffffff12360|r Flame Damage over |cffffff24|r seconds.

skills.name: Degeneration
skills.description:
Bind an enemy with chaotic magic, dealing |cffffff19956|r Magic Damage over |cffffff22|r seconds.

Excess magic spills out from them, granting you Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff22|r seconds.

skills.name: Summon Unstable Clannfear
skills.description:
Command the powers of Oblivion to send a Daedric clannfear to fight at your side. The clannfear's headbutt deals |cffffff1502|r Physical Damage, while its tail spike hits nearby enemies for |cffffff1587|r Physical Damage after |cffffff1|r second.  

Once summoned, you can activate the clannfear's special ability for |cffffff3499|r Magicka, healing you for |cffffff6398|r and the clannfear for |cffffff3198|r.

The clannfear remains until killed or unsummoned.

skills.name: Inner Light
skills.description:
Conjure a mote of magelight, revealing stealthed and invisible enemies around you for |cffffff7|r seconds. Exposed enemies cannot return to stealth or invisibility for |cffffff4|r seconds. The light is so brilliant that you cannot conceal your presence while active.

While slotted gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r% and your Max Magicka is increased by |cffffff5|r%.

skills.name: Ice Comet
skills.description:
Call a comet down from the constellations to blast an enemy, dealing |cffffff20382|r Frost Damage to all enemies in the area, knocking them down and stunning them for |cffffff2|r seconds.

One second after impact, enemies in the target area take |cffffff6679|r Frost Damage every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff12|r seconds.

Enemies damaged by either portion have their Movement Speed reduced by |cffffff50|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

classPassives.name: Unholy Knowledge
classPassives.description: Reduces the Health, Magicka, and Stamina costs of your non Core Combat abilities by |cffffff6|r%.

classPassives.name: Blood Magic
classPassives.description:
When you cast a Dark Magic ability with a cost, you heal for |cffffff1199|r Health if you are not at full Health. This portion of the ability scales off your Max Health.

If your Health is full, the higher of your Max Magicka or Stamina is increased by |cffffff10|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds.

classPassives.name: Persistence
classPassives.description: After blocking an attack, your next Health, Magicka, or Stamina ability costs |cffffff18|r% less.

classPassives.name: Exploitation
classPassives.description: Attempting to activate a Dark Magic skill grants you and your group |cffffff2974|r Offensive Penetration for |cffffff20|r seconds.

classPassives.name: Rebate
classPassives.description: You restore |cffffff371|r Magicka or Stamina when one of your non-Ultimate Daedric Summoning abilities end. The resource returned is dictated by the ability's cost.

classPassives.name: Power Stone
classPassives.description: Reduces the cost of your Ultimate abilities by |cffffff15|r%.

classPassives.name: Daedric Protection
classPassives.description: Reduce your damage taken by |cffffff5|r% while you have a Daedric Summoning ability active.

classPassives.name: Expert Summoner
classPassives.description:
Increases your Magicka and Stamina by |cffffff5|r%.

Increases your Max Health by |cffffff5|r% if you have a permanent summoned combat pet active.

classPassives.name: Catalyst
classPassives.description: After drinking a potion you gain |cffffff22|r Ultimate.

classPassives.name: Magicka Flood
classPassives.description: Increases your Max Magicka and Stamina by |cffffff6|r%.

classPassives.name: Soul Siphoner

skills.name: Hardened Ward
skills.description:
Conjure globes of Daedric energy for protection, granting a damage shield for you and your pets that absorbs |cffffff14353|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds.

This ability scales off the higher of your Max Health or Magicka and the shield is capped at |cffffff72|r% of your Max Health.

Conjure a mote of magelight, revealing stealthed and invisible enemies around you for |cffffff7|r seconds. Exposed enemies cannot return to stealth or invisibility for |cffffff4|r seconds. The light is so brilliant that you cannot conceal your presence while active.

While transformed, your Max Health, Magicka, and Stamina are increased by |cffffff10000|r, you heal for |cffffff16|r% of all damage you deal, and you can see enemies through walls.

As an abattoir of death, no remnants of life are wasted.

Death's knell is a familiar song. Share it with your enemies.

Consuming or replacing this effect forcibly triggers rank 1 of Corpse Consumption's Ultimate generation and triggers rank 2 of Death Gleaning.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

The cycle of life and death continues: you will live, others will die.

Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

When you take damage you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to heal |cffffff2093|r Health and restore |cffffff5|r% of your missing Stamina, up to once per second. This chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every missing Health percent you have and the healing is based off your Max Health.

passives.description:

While you are in combat, directly healing a target below |cffffff66|r% Health relinquishes them from death's clutches and allows you to use a corpse consuming ability against them within |cffffff10|r seconds, up to once every second. 

Extends the duration of Major Vulnerability you apply by |cffffff50|r%.

While Sacred Ground is active, you heal for |cffffff1674|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. If you are at full Health after being healed from this effect while in combat, you also gain |cffffff2|r Ultimate.
